mapper.sql: select l.logistics_id, l.out_bill_id, b.bill_no, l.carrier, l.tracking_no, l.consignee, l.destination, l.ship_date, l.remark, l.del_flag, l.create_by, l.create_time, l.update_by, l.update_time from trace_logistics l left join trace_warehouse_bill b on b.bill_id = l.out_bill_id
mapper.select:
where l.del_flag = '0'
and l.out_bill_id = #{outBillId}
and b.bill_no like concat('%', #{outBillNo}, '%')
and l.carrier like concat('%', #{carrier}, '%')
and l.tracking_no like concat('%', #{trackingNo}, '%')
order by l.ship_date desc, l.logistics_id desc
